name: vehicle-track-soil
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 车辆、轨道及土体共同组成的动力系统。

complete_examples.text: In this paper, a hybrid integration method based on the implicit scheme and Green’s function is introduced and combined with the cyclic calculation method and the multi-time-step solution method to optimize the dynamic procedure for high-efficient solution of vehicle-track-soil (VTS) dynamic interaction.

P063.title: An efficient model for vehicle-track-soil dynamic interaction based on Green's function, cyclic calculation and multi-time-step solution methods
